voice_priority.description: If true, any span where voice is detected is always kept, regardless of amplitude.

other_sound_threshold_pct.description: When no voice is present, a span is kept only if its RMS amplitude (20ms windows) reaches this percent of full scale (0-100). Ignored when adaptive_threshold is true.

adaptive_threshold.description: If true, use a per-scene local threshold instead of the single clip-wide other_sound_threshold_pct. Fixes quiet talkers being cut in a louder scene (background chatter, other speakers) where their voice still sits well above the ambient level around them but under a clip-wide cutoff. Off by default - existing configs are unaffected.

adaptive_window_s.description: Size (seconds) of the centered rolling window used to estimate the local ambient/background noise floor. Only used when adaptive_threshold is true.

adaptive_local_percentile.description: Percentile within the local window treated as the ambient noise floor (low = quietest moments nearby). Only used when adaptive_threshold is true.

adaptive_ratio.description: A window is kept if its RMS is at least this many times the local noise floor. Only used when adaptive_threshold is true.

adaptive_floor_pct.description: Absolute safety-net minimum (percent of full scale) under the local threshold, so a long near-silent stretch isn't treated as signal just because it's the loudest thing nearby. Only used when adaptive_threshold is true.

min_silence_ms.description: Silences shorter than this are ignored (not cut) to avoid reacting to breaths/plosives.

pre_roll_padding_ms.description: Extra time kept before a detected sound span starts.

post_roll_padding_ms.description: Extra time kept after a detected sound span ends.

vad_confidence_threshold.description: Minimum Silero VAD confidence to count a frame as voice.

min_segment_duration_ms.description: Final kept spans shorter than this (after padding/merging) are dropped entirely. A span still this short even after padding almost never came from real speech - it's a transient (click, tap, breath) that briefly crossed the amplitude threshold, and shows up as a jarring isolated blip in the cut.
